content: अरण {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Departed, gone away; belonging to others, strange, unusual, foreign; distant, remote (<ab>opp.</ab> स्व, नित्य or अमा); (<ls>Sāy.</ls> grieved, sorry दुःखित, अरममाण); inimical, hostile, (with whom one is not on speaking terms). .²2 Not fighting. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Moving, going. .²2 Entering into, being inserted. .²3 A refuge; बिभेति यस्मादरणं ततो नः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 9. 21</ls>.
